name: Nezha
subtitle: Heaven’s Rebel
description: Fight in Defiance as you Aetherburn foes and are Reborn from the Flames.
lore: A born warrior, Nezha slew divine beings even as a child—sometimes accidentally, sometimes for pride. Deified by the common folk, he is immensely popular, for he protects them and proves swift to answer prayers. To Tian’s celestial bureaucracy, however, he is a danger to be watched, for his prideful temper may cause further death, or even war with other realms.
divinity_generator: Gain [30] Divinity when inflicting damage to enemies. Gain an additional [15] Divinity if the target is under [Aetherburn II].

awakening_bonuses.bonus: Attunement Multiplier +25%, Weapon Multiplier +15%, Armor Multiplier +15%

skills.name: Windfire Wheel Dash
skills.description: Attack 1 enemy 3 times (4%HP+50%ATK). Each hit has a 35% chance to place [mechanic:aetherburn-ii] on the target for 2 turns.

skills.name: Child of Defiance
skills.description: Attack (8%HP+100%ATK)4 times at random. Each hit increases the Turn Meter of this hero by 5%. If the enemy is under [mechanic:aetherburn] ignore 5% of the target’s DEF.

skills.name: Sacrificial Surge
skills.description: At the start of this hero’s turn, sacrifice 15% of this hero’s current HP and increase the damage of the next attack by 30%.Cannot reduce HP if below 1% HP.
skills.awakening_bonus: Increase the damage of the next attack by 60% instead.

skills.name: Lotus Rebirth
skills.description: Place [mechanic:atk-up-ii] on this hero for 3 turns, then attack all enemies (12%HP+120%ATK). If this hero’s Current HP is below 50%, place [Pheonix] on this hero for 1 turn.
skills.awakening_bonus: [Pheonix] duration will not reduce per turn.

imprint_passive:
At the start of this hero’s turn, sacrifice 15% of this hero’s current HP and increase the damage of the next attack by 15%.
Cannot reduce HP if below 1% HP.
